core.role: Primary brand accent — stability, the system, trust. Named for the 'Core' in CoreFlow.

flow.role: Secondary accent — action, movement, energy. Named for the 'Flow' in CoreFlow. Use for CTAs, highlights, and the second color in the two-tone mark.

ink.role: Near-black text/ground for dark surfaces. Not pure black — carries a slight cool bias toward Core.

paper.role: Light neutral ground. Not pure white — carries a slight cool bias toward Core.

neutral.role: Mid-tone for secondary text/borders on light surfaces.

core-dark-mode.role: Lightened Core for sufficient contrast on dark (Ink) backgrounds.

flow-dark-mode.role: Lightened Flow for sufficient contrast on dark (Ink) backgrounds.

display.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — free for commercial use
display.use: Headlines, the wordmark, section titles. Use with restraint — this is the personality face, not the workhorse.

body.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — free for commercial use
body.use: Running text, UI labels, body copy on the marketing site and collateral.

mono.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — free for commercial use
mono.use: Data, numbers, captions, technical labels — anywhere alignment/precision matters.

logo.sourceFormat: SVG, 100x100 viewBox, colors as literal hex values (not CSS variables) for portability
logo.status: LOCKED — Direction A (Threshold) selected 2026-08-24. Other five directions kept only as historical/comparison record.

locked.name: Threshold
locked.notes: Wordmark uses <text font-family> referencing Bricolage Grotesque — renders correctly wherever the Google Font is loaded (web/Artifact contexts), but is not a portable print-ready vector. True offline/print portability requires outlining the text to paths with a font tool, which was not performed here. PNG/raster exports at standard sizes are still outstanding — no raster-export tool was available in this session.
